bottleneck_hypothesis.area: Investigation and clarifying the exact release-specific change
bottleneck_hypothesis.reason: Largest weak-label category; source reconstruction, unresolved targets and values, and variant applicability require review.
bottleneck_hypothesis.calendar_delay: Dependency, approval, resource or scientific-test waits may dominate calendar time; no observations rank these.

quality_review_flags.interpretation: Narrow text-pattern review candidates, not confirmed errors or a corrected label set. Counts can overlap. Frozen labels unchanged.

interventions.title: Prepare one evidence packet per change
interventions.reduction: Reduce repeated searching with dated source excerpts, prior implementation links, release associations and explicit unanswered questions.
interventions.engineer_decision: Confirm release applicability and resolve changing or conflicting instructions.

interventions.title: Require a complete change record
interventions.reduction: Capture exact target, approved old/new value or pinned artifact, affected variants and acceptance checks before handoff.
interventions.engineer_decision: Approve intended values, scope and acceptance criteria; historical status does not approve a new execution.

interventions.title: Run routine checks immediately
interventions.reduction: After approval, use registered operations and check expected values, hashes, paths and affected variants; expose a reviewable diff.
interventions.engineer_decision: Review changes and separate structural checks from scientific/physical validation. Current real executor coverage is narrow.

interventions.title: Prepare reproducible debugging evidence
interventions.reduction: Collect last-known-working versus candidate differences and approved regression results so investigation begins with a reproducible case.
interventions.engineer_decision: Determine and validate the fix; source collection alone cannot establish root cause.

timing.scope_note: Observed matched tasks only; not a forecast or causal effect estimate.

caveats: Categories are unreviewed action excerpts, not unique completed engineering tasks.
Category shares are not effort shares, validated automation eligibility or time savings.
Flagged labels require human review; original labels, models and frozen campaign remain unchanged.
No observed human timing means savings are unknown, not zero.
Matched timing is descriptive; order, learning and task selection can bias comparisons.
